`chess.js` is the **unmodified** `package/dist/esm/chess.js` browser ESM distribution.
SHA-256: `76c7c34f0e2e9ab076521a5d6fe786a9cce537bb1b6f29d32a9c9970b5b232d2`.
The package contents, manifest, distribution and license were inspected before copying.
The optional source map referenced by the distribution is not included. There are no runtime
imports, external assets, npm install step or runtime CDN requests for this library.

This library supplies legal moves, notation, history and game outcomes only. It is not a chess AI.
The demo scores legal moves through the site's shared kevala classifier. Threefold repetition
and the fifty-move rule end the demo game automatically (no separate claim step), alongside
checkmate, stalemate and the library's insufficient-material detection.
